title: Data Policy
dataIntro: We collect only the minimum data needed to run the app and keep your account working across devices.
dataLocalOnly: Conversation history and downloaded files can stay on your device unless you choose a sync feature.

items.name: Email address
items.purpose: Used for sign-in and account recovery.
items.retention: Deleted when the account is deleted.

items.name: Nickname and profile image
items.purpose: Shown in your profile and community features.
items.retention: Deleted when the account is deleted.

items.name: Chat and reading history
items.purpose: Restores conversations, bookmarks, and reading progress.
items.retention: Removed when you delete the account or clear local data.

items.name: Library activity
items.purpose: Keeps favorites, follows, and recommendations in sync.
items.retention: Deleted when the account is deleted.

items.name: Device OS and app version
items.purpose: Used for compatibility checks and support.
items.retention: Stored only as long as needed for support and diagnostics.

items.name: Local cache
items.purpose: Speeds up loading and resume behavior.
items.retention: Automatically cleaned after a period of inactivity.

permissionsIntro: The following permissions are requested only when a related feature is used.
permissionsDeniedNote: If you deny an optional permission, the core service still works, but that feature may be limited.

permissions.reason: Needed to load stories, sync your library, and reach network services.
Requested only when you choose files or upload an image.
Used for announcements and followed content updates.
Requested only when you take a profile or upload photo inside the app.

retentionRows.label: Chat history
retentionRows.value: Stored on device or deleted with account removal.

retentionRows.label: Account info (server)
retentionRows.value: Removed within 30 days after verified deletion.

retentionRows.label: Analytics logs
retentionRows.value: Retained in aggregated or anonymized form for up to 12 months.

retentionRows.label: Local cache
retentionRows.value: Deleted automatically after inactivity or app removal.

retentionRows.label: Encryption
retentionRows.value: Server AES-256 and secure on-device storage where available.

legalRetention: Records that must be stored for legal, accounting, or fraud-prevention reasons are kept for the required period and then deleted.
childPrivacyIntro: This service is intended for users age 13 and older. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under the applicable minimum age.
childPrivacyLawNote: If you believe a child submitted personal data to us by mistake, contact the address below so we can review and remove it.
applicableLawsValue: COPPA (US), GDPR Article 8 (EU), and local child privacy rules where applicable.
thirdPartyIntro: We share limited data only with partners that help us operate the service, measure stability, or deliver consent-based advertising.

thirdParties.name: Firebase
thirdParties.purpose: Authentication, notifications, and basic cloud delivery.

deletionIntro: When you request deletion, account data, reading progress, bookmarks, and synced history are removed or scheduled for removal.
deletionBackupNote: Encrypted backups are deleted according to the provider retention schedule after the request is completed.
method1Desc: Send a deletion request by email and we will process it after verifying the account.
method2Desc: If you are signed in, the button below clears local data immediately and starts account deletion.
deleteConfirmMessage:
Deleting the account also removes synced data, reading progress, and local history.
This action cannot be undone.

Do you want to continue?
deleteError: Something went wrong while deleting the account. Please contact support.

rights.title: Access
rights.desc: Request a copy of the data we hold about you.

rights.title: Correction
rights.desc: Ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.

rights.title: Deletion
rights.desc: Request deletion of your account data and synced history.

rights.title: Portability
rights.desc: Request your data in a portable format where applicable.

rightsNote: To exercise these rights, contact fdje0303@gmail.com. We normally respond within 30 days.
